verdict.rationale: Docs describe 'Shared drives' as storage accessible from multiple machines in a private network, and Machines/Notebooks as having 'persistent storage' independent of any single GPU rental, directly supporting durable dataset/checkpoint storage that outlives an instance. However, the evidence never explicitly states that storage survives full instance deletion (only stop/creation flows) and there's no first-hand or independent confirmation of this persistence behavior. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that storage survives instance termination/deletion (not just stop), and independent/hands-on verification of persistence across teardown.
